people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations; from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
translations.bsb: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations—from Edom and Moab, and from the Ammonites, Philistines, and Amalekites.
translations.kjv: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
translations.asv: These also did king David dedicate unto Jehovah, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
